about: Labelled questions for measuring the backend chat grounding gate (scripts/measure-grounding.ts). expect: 'grounded' = VedaMD content covers it and the named subject (and topic field, if given) must reach the model; 'refuse' = a clinical-fact question the bundle does not cover, which must be refused without calling the model; 'general' = a general question that may be answered as labelled general knowledge. Absent drugs were checked against content/bundles/v0.1.0 when this file was written.
